test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the word from the sentence below, which is an antonym for the word ‘advance’.

Clive is a travel blogger who believes that with even an elementary or intermediate Knowledge of the local language, you can enjoy your travel more.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **‘elementary’ **means** basic or simple**, which is the opposite of **‘advance’** that implies progress or higher level.
 
• In the given sentence, the** context indicates a basic or initial level of knowledge, which aligns with the meaning of ‘elementary’.**
 
• Therefore,** ‘elementary’ is the correct antonym for ‘advance’ in this context.**

Hence, the correct sentence is** "*Clive is a travel blogger who believes that with even an elementary__ or intermediate knowledge of the local language, you can enjoy your travel more."***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• In general, when looking for antonyms, consider the context of the sentence to ensure the chosen word fits appropriately.
 
• Advanced knowledge would imply a higher level of understanding, whereas elementary knowledge implies a basic, foundational level.
